items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: It was Neils Henning was playing bass, and Kenny Drew was playing piano.

ctx.x: Usually it’s in B flat, so it was kind of a half step. And so he played a brilliant rhythm solo. But I was also doing the ugly fan thing — I was standing on stage saying wow, this is Dexter Gordon. I have all his records. But the rhythm section was great. It was Neils Henning was playing bass, and Kenny Drew was playing piano. And they knew what Dexter was doing. And Kenny Drew just kind of rolled his eyes. And he walked me through it. The chord changes — every change was like riding on rails [claps]. There was…
I’m sorry, I can just hear his voice too, his slow way of talking, down here. Oh that’s great.
